title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: How we process your personal data

sections.title: 1. General information
content: This policy applies to the website softwave-labs.com
The data administrator is Antoni Tabaczka, Masztowa 10, 61-345 Poznań, Poland.
Contact: kontakt@kacperglodowski.pl
Data is processed for: handling contact forms, delivering ordered services, and direct marketing.

sections.title: 2. Data protection
content: All connections are encrypted using an SSL certificate.
User passwords are stored in hashed form and cannot be reversed.
The operator regularly updates all software used to process personal data.

sections.title: 3. Hosting
content: The website is hosted on lh.pl servers.
The hosting provider maintains server logs including IP addresses, URLs, request timestamps, and browser information.

sections.title: 4. Your rights
content: You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict processing of, and transfer your data.
You may object to processing of your data for marketing purposes.
You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Polish Data Protection Authority (UODO), ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw.
Your data is not transferred outside the European Union.

sections.title: 5. Forms
content: The website collects data voluntarily provided by users through contact forms.
Data is processed solely for handling enquiries or commercial contact.
The website may log connection parameters such as timestamp and IP address.

sections.title: 6. Marketing techniques
content: The website uses Google Analytics for anonymous traffic analysis.
Remarketing techniques are used to tailor ads to user behaviour — no personal data is shared.
The Facebook Pixel is used, which informs Facebook that a registered user has visited the site.
Heatmaps and session recordings are used — all data is anonymised before transmission.

sections.title: 7. Cookies
content: The website uses cookies — small text files stored on the user's device.
Cookies are used to maintain user sessions and support marketing activities.
Two types of cookies are used: session cookies (temporary) and persistent cookies (stored for a set period).
You can manage cookies through your browser settings: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, Opera.
